topics.title: Anchor Standard 1: Generate and conceptualize artistic ideas

outcomes.text: Use digital tools to come up with melodic, rhythmic and harmonic ideas for compositions or improvisations.

topics.title: Anchor Standard 2: Organize and develop artistic ideas

subtopics.title: Developing ideas into a larger work

outcomes.text: Choose melodic, rhythmic and harmonic ideas and grow them into a larger work with digital tools.

topics.title: Anchor Standard 3: Refine and complete artistic work

outcomes.text: Use teacher and peer feedback to plan and apply strategies that improve the technical and expressive sides of draft pieces.
Share work showing proficient musical and technological craft and digital tools for organizing ideas.

topics.title: Anchor Standard 4: Select, analyze, and interpret artistic work for presentation

outcomes.text: Develop and explain criteria for picking varied repertoire, based on interest, reading skills and the performer's technical and technology skills.
Describe how context, musical structure and digital tools inform prepared and improvised performances.
Show how understanding context, expressive challenges and digital tools in varied repertoire influences performances.

topics.title: Anchor Standard 5: Develop and refine artistic techniques and work for presentation

outcomes.text: Identify and use rehearsal strategies to improve technical and expressive parts of performances.

topics.title: Anchor Standard 6: Convey meaning through the presentation of artistic work

outcomes.text: Use digital tools to show attention to technical accuracy and expression in performances of varied music.
Show understanding of the music's context through prepared and improvised performances.

topics.title: Anchor Standard 7: Perceive and analyze artistic work

outcomes.text: Give reasons for choosing music based on elements of music, digital and electronic aspects, and interest or purpose.
Explain how structure (repetition, similarity, contrast), technology and purpose inform a response to music.

topics.title: Anchor Standard 8: Interpret intent and meaning in artistic work

outcomes.text: Explain and support an interpretation of expressive intent from treatment of musical elements, digital features and purpose.

topics.title: Anchor Standard 9: Apply criteria to evaluate artistic work

outcomes.text: Evaluate music with criteria drawn from analysis, interpretation, digital features and personal interests.

topics.title: Anchor Standard 10: Relate artistic ideas and works with societal, cultural, and historical context

outcomes.text: Show how personal interests, knowledge and skills relate to choices and intent in creating, performing and responding to music.

topics.title: Anchor Standard 11: Synthesize and relate knowledge and personal experiences to make art

outcomes.text: Show understanding of how music relates to other arts, other subjects, varied contexts and daily life.

topics.title: Anchor Standard 1: Generate and conceptualize artistic ideas

outcomes.text: Generate melodic, rhythmic and harmonic ideas that build digital tools, resources and systems into compositions and improvisations.

topics.title: Anchor Standard 2: Organize and develop artistic ideas

subtopics.title: Developing ideas into a larger work

outcomes.text: Select, develop and organize many ideas into a larger work with unity, variety, complexity and coherence, using digital and analog tools and systems.

topics.title: Anchor Standard 3: Refine and complete artistic work

outcomes.text: Develop varied strategies and apply suitable criteria to refine the technical and expressive aspects of drafts.
Share a portfolio of varied styles and genres showing advanced musical and technological craft with digital and analog tools and systems.

topics.title: Anchor Standard 4: Select, analyze, and interpret artistic work for presentation

outcomes.text: Develop and apply criteria to pick varied programs, weighing interest, theory, structure, expressive challenges and skill, using digital tools and systems.
Examine, evaluate and critique how context, theory, structure and digital tools influence performances.
Show how understanding style, genre, context and integrated digital technology informs performance and audience connection.

topics.title: Anchor Standard 5: Develop and refine artistic techniques and work for presentation

outcomes.text: Apply criteria and feedback from many sources and use varied strategies to refine performances of varied programs.

topics.title: Anchor Standard 6: Convey meaning through the presentation of artistic work

outcomes.text: Combine digital and analog tools to show understanding of accuracy and expression across cultures, styles, genres and periods.
Connect with audience members before a performance and engage and respond to them during it.

topics.title: Anchor Standard 7: Perceive and analyze artistic work

outcomes.text: Select, describe and compare varied pieces using their characteristics, digital and electronic aspects, purpose and context.
Demonstrate and justify how analyzing structure, context, and technological and creative decisions informs interest and response.

topics.title: Anchor Standard 8: Interpret intent and meaning in artistic work

outcomes.text: Use research and multiple sources to connect how elements, digital features, context, purpose and other arts shape expressive intent.

topics.title: Anchor Standard 9: Apply criteria to evaluate artistic work

outcomes.text: Develop and justify evaluations of varied music using established and personal criteria, features, purpose and context.

topics.title: Anchor Standard 10: Relate artistic ideas and works with societal, cultural, and historical context

outcomes.text: Show how personal interests, knowledge and skills relate to choices and intent in creating, performing and responding to music.

topics.title: Anchor Standard 11: Synthesize and relate knowledge and personal experiences to make art

outcomes.text: Show understanding of how music relates to other arts, other subjects, varied contexts and daily life.
